caveats: 308 of the 3600 region grid cells (Polish Pomeranian coast and adjacent coastal cells) are not sea cells (non-finite SST on at least one target day) and are set to 0; all 3292 sea cells had finite daily thresholds. Per the method, MHW detection is restricted to the target period, so the single regional event begins on the first target day (2021-06-01) and the underlying warm spell may have started earlier. The 90th percentile was computed with numpy method='hazen' (per the task specification, MATLAB quantile default), ignoring NaNs.
